surface: The column dropdown menu of a right-to-left grid: opening it from the keyboard, End to the Alignment item, ArrowLeft into its submenu and ArrowRight back, as the direction swaps the keys, and Escape back to the grid.

steps.note: Shift+Alt+ArrowDown on B2 of the right-to-left grid opens its column's menu with the first item highlighted. Required: the item and the menu role.
End highlights the last item, Alignment, the parent of a submenu.
In a right-to-left grid ArrowLeft opens the submenu, toward the side it opens on, with its first item, Left, highlighted.
ArrowRight closes the submenu, and the highlight should return to Alignment.
Escape closes the menu, and the focus should return to the grid. Opening the menu from the keyboard selects the whole column and clamps the focus cell to row 0, so the cell is B1.
